# STM32F1 CMSIS device headers

Unmodified subset of https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/cmsis-device-f1,
release v4.3.5, commit 8a76309ed1250d817e9c888c4417171d2ba3ba63.
Only STM32F100xB and its system declarations are included. See License.md.
HomeCore provides clock initialization; ST's system/startup sources are not linked.
